cues.en: From the previous several videos.
cues.zh: 從前幾支影片，

cues.en: You already have an idea that some functions at some points have different limits depending on whether you're approaching from the left or from the right.
cues.zh: 你已經知道，有些函數在某些點，會因為從左邊還是右邊趨近，而有不同的極限。

cues.en: Those are so-called one sided limits, and I'm going to talk more about those in more detail in this video.
cues.zh: 這就是所謂的單側極限，這支影片會更詳細地討論。

cues.en: And then I'll also talk a little bit about limits at infinities, both positive and negative and also one sided versus two sided limits.
cues.zh: 接著也會談一點正、負無窮大的極限，以及單側極限和雙側極限。

cues.en: I'd like to start with the example at the end of the previous video.
cues.zh: 我想先從上一支影片結尾的例子開始。

cues.en: So there the question was what is the limit of this function as X approaches to.
cues.zh: 當時的問題是，x 趨近 2 時，這個函數的極限是多少？

cues.en: Well, in this case, it actually doesn't make sense to talk about the limit.
cues.zh: 這種情況，其實不能單純談「那個極限」。

cues.en: In fact, there are two limits depending on whether we approach the target value here to from the left or from the right.
cues.zh: 實際上有兩個極限，取決於我們從左邊還是右邊，趨近這裡的目標值 2。

cues.en: So there are two one sided limits, both of which are perfectly valid, Exactly.
cues.zh: 所以有兩個單側極限，它們都完全有效，完全

cues.en: Consistent with the definition of a limit.
cues.zh: 符合極限的定義。

cues.en: It's just that the left and the right limits are not equal to each other.
cues.zh: 只是左極限與右極限不相等。

cues.en: And in general, the left and the right limits do not need to be equal to each other.
cues.zh: 一般來說，左、右極限不必彼此相等。

cues.en: They can be different.
cues.zh: 它們可以不同。

cues.en: So in this example, the limit as X approaches to from the left equals minus one and the limit as x equals to from the right equals plus one.
cues.zh: 這個例子裡，x 從左側趨近 2 時，極限等於 −1；x 從右側趨近 2 時，極限等於正 1。

cues.en: So it's pretty obvious from looking at this graph here and the two sided limit is, well, it just it isn't defined, it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 從這張圖可以很明顯看出來。而雙側極限則沒有定義，不存在。

cues.en: In fact, the function itself is undefined at X equals two because that gives us zero over zero.
cues.zh: 事實上，這個函數本身在 x 等於 2 時也沒有定義，因為會得到零除以零。

cues.en: So two perfectly acceptable one sided limits, but they're different from each other and the function is undefined at that point.
cues.zh: 所以有兩個完全合理的單側極限，但它們彼此不同，而且函數在那個點沒有定義。

cues.en: Now, in general it can happen that the limits are different from the left and the right, But you should not generalize that last point that I just made.
cues.zh: 一般來說，左、右極限確實可能不同，但你不應該把我剛才最後那一點也一概而論。

cues.en: So having unequal one sided limits does not necessarily mean that the function is undefined at that point.
cues.zh: 單側極限不相等，並不一定表示函數在那個點沒有定義。

cues.en: Here is a counterexample.
cues.zh: 這裡有個反例。

cues.en: This is called the heavy side function.
cues.zh: 這叫作 Heaviside 函數。

cues.en: It is equal to zero for all non positive values of x and equals one for all positive values of x.
cues.zh: 所有非正的 x 值都對應到 0，所有正的 x 值都對應到 1。

cues.en: So heaviside function it's often given this label h of x.
cues.zh: 所以是 Heaviside 函數，經常用 h(x) 這個記號表示。

cues.en: Now notice that this function is defined everywhere, including at this jump discontinuity here.
cues.zh: 注意，這個函數處處都有定義，包括這裡的跳躍不連續點。

cues.en: So the two one sided limits as x approaches zero are zero when we approach from the left and plus one when we approach from the right.
cues.zh: 所以 x 趨近零時，兩個單側極限分別是：從左邊趨近時為 0，從右邊趨近時為正 1。

cues.en: But there is no two sided limit of this function.
cues.zh: 但這個函數沒有雙側極限。

cues.en: So we could write that the limit of the heaviside function as X goes to zero does not exist any does not exist.
cues.zh: 因此可以寫，x 趨近零時，Heaviside 函數的極限不存在，也就是 DNE。

cues.en: Now, what you definitely can generalize from this and the previous example is that if a function has
cues.zh: 從這個和上一個例子，你確實可以推廣的一點是：如果函數在

cues.en: two different one sided limits at some point, then the function is discontinuous at that point.
cues.zh: 某個點有兩個不同的單側極限，那麼函數在那裡就不連續。

cues.en: And in fact, the equality of the two one sided limits is part of the definition of continuity.
cues.zh: 事實上，兩個單側極限相等，是連續性定義的一部分。

cues.en: So limits can differ on the left and on the right.
cues.zh: 所以左右兩邊的極限可以不同。

cues.en: Now let me talk about the two infinite limits, positive infinity and negative infinity.
cues.zh: 接著談兩種無窮極限：正無窮大與負無窮大。

cues.en: Now, you've already seen examples of these in previous videos, but I just want to make sure we're all on the same page about this so a function can shoot up to infinity as it approaches some point.
cues.zh: 前面的影片已經看過例子，但我想確保大家理解一致。函數在趨近某個點時，可能會衝到無窮大。

cues.en: Like what you see in this function, you generally see this kind of behavior when X is in the denominator,
cues.zh: 就像這個函數。通常 x 在分母時，會看到這種行為，

cues.en: because then as the denominator gets arbitrarily close to zero, which might be x plus some offset, then the function will just grow and grow and grow.
cues.zh: 因為分母任意接近零時，可能是 x 加上某個位移量，函數就會不斷增長。

cues.en: So in this example, the limit is defined and equals infinity when coming from both the left side and from the right side of this particular x axis value.
cues.zh: 這個例子裡，從這個 x 軸數值的左側和右側趨近，極限都有定義，而且都等於無窮大。

cues.en: So this function has a left sided one sided limit from the left, a one sided limit from the right,
cues.zh: 所以這個函數有從左邊趨近的單側極限、從右邊趨近的單側極限，

cues.en: and a two sided limit here, because both the left and the right side limits are equal to each other.
cues.zh: 也有雙側極限，因為左、右極限彼此相等。

cues.en: And well, you can probably guess what is going to go here.
cues.zh: 你大概也猜到，接下來會出現什麼。

cues.en: Here is a function that has two one sided limits that go to infinity, but they go to infinity in opposite directions.
cues.zh: 這裡有個函數，兩個單側極限都趨向無窮大，但方向相反。

cues.en: So the one sided limit exists for both the negative and the positive side, but those are different from each other.
cues.zh: 所以負側和正側的單側極限都存在，但它們彼此不同。

cues.en: So the limit as X goes to A in this function does not exist.
cues.zh: 因此，這個函數在 x 趨近 a 時的極限不存在。

cues.en: And this leads me to the final point that I want to make in this lecture, which is about some notation and convention.
cues.zh: 這帶到這堂課的最後一點，也就是一些記號與慣例。

cues.en: Well, I think you've probably already guessed this notation, but let's just go through it anyway to make sure we're all on the same page.
cues.zh: 我想你可能已經猜到這些記號，不過我們還是一起看一次，確保理解一致。

cues.en: So these two notations are called one sided limits because there is a minus sign meaning coming from
cues.zh: 這兩種記號叫作單側極限，因為在 x 所趨近的數字右上角，減號表示從

cues.en: the left or relatively negative and a plus sign meaning coming from the right or relatively positive in the superscript of the number that X is approaching.
cues.zh: 左側，也就是相對較負的一側趨近；加號則表示從右側，也就是相對較正的一側趨近。

cues.en: So these are called one sided limits and when it's not otherwise specified.
cues.zh: 所以它們叫單側極限。如果沒有特別指明，

cues.en: So when you don't see a plus or minus here in the superscript, then the two sided limit is implied and.
cues.zh: 也就是右上角沒有加號或減號，就隱含指的是雙側極限。

cues.en: In fact, you generally don't even say two sided.
cues.zh: 事實上，通常連「雙側」都不會說。

cues.en: I put them in parentheses here.
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡把它放在括號裡。

cues.en: So you generally don't actually explicitly call it the two sided limit, except when you need to differentiate it from the one sided limit.
cues.zh: 一般不會特別稱它為雙側極限，除非需要和單側極限區分。

cues.en: So when you see this kind of notation, you would just read or say or hear the limit.
cues.zh: 所以看到這種記號，通常就直接讀作、說成或聽到「極限」。

cues.en: And when you hear the limit, it means the two sided limit.
cues.zh: 而當你聽到「極限」，指的就是雙側極限。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what is the relationship between the two one sided limits and the two sided limit?
cues.zh: 兩個單側極限與雙側極限，有什麼關係？

cues.en: Well, the limit of a function at a point exists only when both one side of the limits are equal to each other.
cues.zh: 函數在某點的極限，只有在兩個單側極限彼此相等時，才會存在。

cues.en: So here you would say that the limit as X approaches A exists, and then it's your job to figure out what that limit actually is.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會說，x 趨近 a 時的極限存在，接著你的工作就是算出那個極限究竟是多少。

cues.en: And if the left and the right side limits, the two one sided limits differ when they're different from each other, then you say that the limit does not exist.
cues.zh: 如果左極限和右極限，也就是兩個單側極限不一樣，就說極限不存在。

cues.en: Danny So I hope you enjoyed this video.
cues.zh: DNE。希望你喜歡這支影片。

cues.en: The goal here was to clarify some points about the one sided and two sided limits that I've actually already introduced in previous videos, but I left it implicit.
cues.zh: 這裡的目標，是釐清前幾支影片其實已經介紹、但沒有明說的單側與雙側極限概念。

cues.en: And here I hope that it's all explicit and clear.
cues.zh: 希望現在一切都明確、清楚了。
